outcome: Fetal complications (umbilical cord pH and base excess, Apgar score)
Postpartum transfer to Neonatal Care Unit
cohort: 1,474 singleton pregnancies with labor induction at or greater than 37 weeks of gestation from January 2010 to December 2013.
finding: While a fetal birth weight under 2500 g and over 4250 g are associated with some risks, there is no general contraindication against performing induction of labor in regards to fetal birth weight.
mod_finding: Second-stage cesarean section is significantly more likely when fetal birth weight is below 2,500 g (OR=3.11) compared to normal birth weight.
birth_weight: Study focused on the impact of birth weight, with categories of <2.5 kg, 2.5-<4 kg, 4-4.25 kg, and ≥4.25 kg
